content:
anna: FYI: large customer flagged a weird billing blip — provisional tokens spiked exactly when a client sent an EOF and retried midstream. looks like a truncated toolcall produced a snapshot and a replayed toolcall both emitting provisional counts.
leo: that sounds like the midstream snapshot + truncation race we've feared. session id?
anna: session=cust-4102, trace=trace-cc5, happened 03/22 09:12 UTC. console shows provisional=240, confirmed=120. telemetry shows two provisional events within 300ms with different origins.
sam: do we have idempotency on toolcalls? last I checked prefetch sidecar didn't attach a stable toolcall_id during partial sends.
leo: right. prefetch emits provisional tokens when it writes a snapshot to the ledger. if client reconnects and replays, router may create a new ephemeral toolcall with no shared id. duplicates.
billing-bot: [alert] billing.spike provisional_high cust-4102 09:12 count=240 confirmed=120
anna: customer unhappy because their dashboard alerted on provisional threshold. they see a temporary overcharge until our daily reconcile runs.
sam: short term: we should prevent provisional totals from triggering external alerts. console already supports hiding provisional in org billing alerts?
leo: not yet globally. product asked for granular control by org. but oncall needs visibility. proposal: exclude provisional-only spikes from billing alert rules unless confirmed within 10 minutes. also add a small warning badge in the UI explaining "provisional pending reconciliation".
anna: medium term: attach a stable toolcall_id and a per-session sequence number at the router/prefetch boundary. ingest pipeline can dedupe by (session, toolcall_id, seq). if snapshot truncated and later replayed, same toolcall_id will avoid double provisional.
sam: agree. implementation note: for partial sends we need the client or sidecar to persist the same toolcall_id across retries. simplest: router generates a toolcall_id on first seen and returns it in heartbeat; client includes it on retries. if missing, generate but mark provenance.
leo: also add provenance fields to billing events: provenance.source (router|sidecar|client), provenance.toolcall_id, provenance.seq. that will help reconcile + investigation.
anna: can you sketch the ingestion dedupe logic?
sam: pseudo Go-ish check we can add to the provisional writer:

```
// when writing provisional event
key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%d", event.SessionID, event.ToolcallID, event.Seq)
if SeenRecently(key) {
  // skip incrementing provisional ledger
  log.Infof("dupe provisional skip %s", key)
  return
}
WriteProvisional(event)
MarkSeen(key, ttl)
```

leo: we should set SeenRecently TTL to maybe 30m to cover short reconnections. reconcile will still handle longer gaps.
anna: also add a lightweight /internal/billing/provenance?session=cust-4102&window=1h endpoint so oncall can quickly inspect duplicates and sources.
sam: agreed. I'll add the endpoint and include counts grouped by provenance.toolcall_id. quick SQL to find dupes in the events table:

```
SELECT toolcall_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(provisional_tokens) AS p_tokens
FROM provisional_events
WHERE session_id = 'cust-4102'
AND recorded_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY toolcall_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```

leo: ops: we'll need a small router flag to opt-in stable toolcall id emission to canary first. can't flip globally until clients/sidecars pick it up.
anna: action items: sam = ingestion + endpoint + draft dedupe; leo = router flag + router->heartbeat change; dana_pt? (cc product) to make UI tweak (hide provisional in alerting and add explanatory badge). I'll ping product.
anna: timeline: UI hotfix this afternoon to stop alarms, router flag to canary tomorrow, ingestion dedupe early next week.
billing-bot: [deploy] ui-hotfix/hide-provisional deployed to canary 12:45 :rocket:
leo: thanks. add runbook entry: "if provisional spike -> call /internal/billing/provenance -> check toolcall_id dupes -> if >=2 duplicate toolcall_id within 30m, escalate to platform oncall".
anna: filing tickets and adding to rollout checklist. customer notified about temporary reconciliation delay. :handshake:
